control.name: ftdi_status
control.doc: Run version command on FTDI UART.

control.name: dut_power
control.doc: Turn DUT power (VBUS on the Maui DUT port) off/on, or cycle it. Returns as soon as the Maui accepted the request; for 'cycle' the PDC turns power back on by itself about 1s later. Cutting power may also disconnect DUT USB devices behind the Maui (e.g. CCD). servod shuts down if such a device stays away (about 40s with default settings), so run e.g. 'dut-control watchdog_remove:ccd_gsc' first.

control.name: dut_data
control.doc: Connect/disconnect the DUT USB2+USB3 data path (and the H2H bridge), or cycle it. 'cycle' returns as soon as it started; data is connected again about 1.3s later and the Maui shell is busy until then. Disconnecting drops DUT USB devices behind the Maui (e.g. CCD). servod shuts down if such a device stays away (about 40s with default settings), so run e.g. 'dut-control watchdog_remove:ccd_gsc' first.
